tests.fail_or_repair: Open an LTSS authority docket and downgrade facility or enrollment rows to denominator evidence.
tests.label: Person, setting, and authority
tests.question: Does the packet identify resident/participant, facility or HCBS setting, payer, admission/service authority, responsible agency, representative or guardian, and rights notice before accepting a care status?

tests.fail_or_repair: Treat the care-plan date as insufficient until delivered care and missed-care evidence is visible.
tests.label: Assessment, care plan, and medication continuity
tests.question: Can assessment, acuity, ADLs/IADLs, medication, dementia/behavioral health, therapy, nursing, diet, infection control, and care-plan changes be joined to actual delivery?

tests.fail_or_repair: Do not cite staffing rules, repeals, or reported hours as safety without delivery and acuity evidence.
tests.label: Staffing and delivered-hours reality
tests.question: Does the packet separate staffing policy or reported hours from actual shifts, acuity fit, weekend/night coverage, home-care worker availability, backup care, and missed visits?

tests.fail_or_repair: Open a resident-rights route before treating posted rights or facility policy as usable rights.
tests.label: Resident rights, consent, and communication
tests.question: Are informed consent, visitation, family contact, privacy, resident council, interpreter, disability accommodation, grievance, and retaliation-safe communication usable?

tests.fail_or_repair: Treat APS intake or NAMRS data as reporting evidence only until protective action and recurrence prevention are visible.
tests.label: APS and elder-justice response
tests.question: Does APS or elder-justice evidence prove intake, investigation, risk assessment, protective services, law enforcement or court action, financial protection, recurrence check, and closure reason?

tests.fail_or_repair: Do not treat ombudsman program existence as remedy without complaint-tail evidence.
tests.label: Ombudsman complaint and remedy tail
tests.question: Does the packet show resident access to the ombudsman, complaint coding, verification, resolution, retaliation protection, systemic escalation, and unresolved-tail status?

tests.fail_or_repair: Treat discharge or transfer as incomplete until receiving-care and follow-up evidence exists.
tests.label: Transfer, discharge, and relocation continuity
tests.question: Before transfer, discharge, closure, hospital-to-post-acute discharge, or evacuation, are notice, lawful basis, appeal, destination, records, medication, transport, receiving-care acceptance, and follow-up proven?

tests.fail_or_repair: Do not cite HCBS enrollment or QMS measures as community living without person-level delivery evidence.
tests.label: HCBS community-living continuity
tests.question: Does HCBS evidence show authorized and delivered hours, provider capacity, backup workers, housing, transportation, technology, caregiver support, emergency backup, and institutional-risk mitigation?

tests.fail_or_repair: Do not treat guardian appointment as protection until authority scope and accountability evidence are visible.
tests.label: Guardianship and fiduciary accountability
tests.question: Does a guardianship/fiduciary packet preserve scope, less-restrictive alternatives, accounting, fees, visitation, medical/property decisions, complaints, and restoration review?

tests.fail_or_repair: Do not cite emergency compliance as readiness without evacuation and continuity execution evidence.
tests.label: Emergency preparedness, evacuation, and closure tail
tests.question: Can the packet prove emergency staffing, transport, receiving beds, medication/records, generator/power, infection control, heat/cooling, family notice, return, and closure/relocation tail?

use_rule: Run long-term-care tests whenever nursing-home provider data, Care Compare ratings, SFF status, staffing rules or repeals, facility-initiated discharge, HCBS enrollment or quality measures, APS/NAMRS data, ombudsman routes, guardianship/fiduciary authority, assisted-living/residential settings, home care, emergency evacuation, closure, medication, restraints, resident rights, or family/caregiver continuity can affect older adults or people with disabilities. Separate setting, authority, care delivery, staffing, rights, APS, ombudsman, transfer/discharge, HCBS, guardianship, emergency, and source-currentness before treating a facility row, HCBS slot, intake, guardian order, or rating as care.
